resolution_note: RESOLVED by the architects: the authoritative first 32 bytes of SHA-512(seed) are sha512_first_half_hex. The handoff's s18 value (kept above only as history) was a transcription error; the clamped scalar, public key and signature were always correct.
note: Ed25519 key material must never be reused as X25519 private key (DSK and DDHK are independent).
